=== F1 (DEMONSTRATED): the general I5 instrument and the size-specific I5 instrument disagree on every countable reading on the SAME artifact ===

Same artifact artifacts/oracle-3x2.wzo (SHA d4d22c0d...), same goban, same graph convention (reachable-from-empty):
  metric            | general vb_graph (verify-battery I5) | size-specific vb_scc_4x4.checkI5Small
  V                 | 2583                                | 2583
  E                 | 7364                                | 5510
  maxSCC            | 1000                                | 1676   (vb_graph.zig:34 cites 1676 as ITS calibration target)
  cycle_reachable   | 2523                                | 1678   (spec.md 3.3 register spread includes 1678)
  ko_sensitive      | 378 (raw artifact flag census = 378) | 347
  ko_not_cr         | 0                                   | 0
  verdict           | pass                                | pass
Both verdicts agree, so the disagreement was invisible at T344's 3x2 calibration rung and the 4x4 reading was certified by an instrument whose counts do not match the general battery's at the overlapping size. Mechanism: vb_graph counts KO_SENSITIVE artifact-wide over stored (colex,side) slots (src/vb_graph.zig:847-869); vb_scc_4x4 counts flags only on graph vertices at (ko=NONE, passes=0) (src/vb_scc_4x4.zig:741-757), and at 4x4 switches to artifact-wide L!=H census (:861-870). A cross-size differential requiring identical readings would have failed this pair before the 4x4 reading.

D4 I7 DTT: WZO1 pass condition (terminals DTT=0, non-terminals !=255) vs WZO2 A8 (non-constant + recurrence); no cross-format differential; battery I7 at 4x4 is battery-bad (T258-F3).

D6 key agreement: table-exhaustive form (T345) exists only at 4x4; game-sampled form (T267) at all sizes; no small-rung exhaustive differential.
D7 closure: WZO2-only (vb_closure.zig), 3x3 + 4x4; t380_ko_slot carries a separate C-A1 counter with its own semantics.
D8 mutation assertions: WZO1-2x2 fixtures (vb_mutants.zig) vs WZO2-4x4 A6 fixtures; mutants.md kill matrix is stale vs vb_mutants.zig (M8/M10 tests exist, rows still SURVIVED, T363 claims 7/7, no catalogue amendment).

=== Proposals (costed, not performed — see coverage doc 3) ===
Unify I5 counting semantics to the artifact-wide census (low); collapse the 3x2/4x3 overlap to one small-goban implementation (moderate); give vb_fixpoint.checkI4 a WZO2 reader or a pluggable Phi core (moderate); adopt A8 DTT recurrence as the single definition (moderate); wire vb_i11 as the battery's I11 runner (low, GAP-5 closed by T346); run T345 table-exhaustive at 3x3 WZO2 (low); port WZO1 mutants to WZO2 at 3x3 and reconcile mutants.md (moderate). Genuinely scale-specific: I5 4x4 bitset/Tarjan (2.8 GB RSS, 1.46B linear space) and full 4x4 closure (600M children, 1.1 GB).

Report and propose only: no instrument rewrites in this row. Every claim cites file:line in the coverage doc.
